**Rigshospitalet Med. Klinik Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd.** (Department of Gastroenterology at Rigshospitalet) is one of Denmark's largest specialized gastroenterological departments, playing a significant role in the national monitoring of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) care through the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD). 

In the context of national quality benchmarking, the department's performance and data contributions are closely tracked. According to the 2023 DANIBD annual report, the department was identified as having the lowest target fulfillment for Indicator 4, achieving only 13% [^src1]. Despite challenges in meeting specific quality metrics, it remains one of the largest contributors of data for Indicator 7, which focuses on colonoscopies for patients with primary sclerosing cholangitis [^src1].

The department's ongoing participation in quality monitoring is further detailed in the 2024 DANIBD report, which evaluates patient populations and specific clinical indicators. For Indicator 4, which tracks the use of [[dexa-scanning|DEXA-scanning]] for patients on steroid treatment, the department reported a 31% fulfillment rate (5 out of 16 eligible patients) [^src3]. For Indicator 5, which measures fecal [[calprotectin|calprotectin]] testing during treatment with biological and small molecule drugs (BMSL), the department recorded a 16% fulfillment rate (43 out of 263 patients) [^src3]. Additionally, the department is listed in the 2024 report's broader empirical data regarding patient demographics, diagnostic distributions, and contact patterns across Danish IBD care facilities [^src2].
